digest.component_or_area: rebar library — transition() API and LLM model resolution
propositions: rebar.transition(force_close=...) and rebar.transition(force=True) must be rejected at the Python library boundary, directing users to force=<reason>
Hosted model selection must reject explicit openai-chat: prefixes while accepting openai-responses: and preserving custom-endpoint Chat Completions routing
Library API surface snapshot and MCP parity manifest must be regenerated to remove force_close entries after signature changes
All test files and documentation must migrate from force_close/force=True/openai-chat: to canonical force=<reason>/openai-responses: equivalents
Generated reference and config documentation must be regenerated to reflect retired hosted openai-chat: and updated model inventory in openai.toml
Historical force_close_reason durable state must be preserved despite removal of the force_close parameter from the public API
